summary: The Assistant Superintendent urges maintaining the current E-Rate program to ensure reliable internet access for student achievement. They argue that reducing funding to influence screen time could restrict access to educational resources and harm learning outcomes.

claims.requested_action: Tie E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes
claims.argument: E-Rate should not tie funding decisions to educational outcomes
claims.evidence_quote: Our schools need the flexibility to use technology in ways that best serve their students. E-Rate should continue doing what it has done so successfully—helping schools provide the reliable, affordable connectivity they need.
